description: Convert letters to Polybius square coordinates (5×5 grid, I/J merged) and decode coordinates back.

faqs.a: Letters sit in a 5×5 grid; each becomes its row+column number (A=11, B=12 … Z=55). I and J share a cell.
faqs.q: How does the Polybius square work?

faqs.a: Type them as digit pairs like 111213, optionally separated by spaces — J decodes as I/J.
Coordinates are read row-first then column-first in the classic layout.

title: Polybius Square Tool
